patchNotes: Restored native-hook compatibility with BMX Streets build 26117410 (October 21 update), including the hooks used by material application, custom hair, Disable Trick Tweaking, and nose-manual/hang-five controls. Re-audited all 17 native targets while preserving earlier supported builds and rejecting unknown binaries and shared functions. Added a visible per-trick speed slider and Reset to 1x in the trick editor, using the existing saved per-trick setting.
